scope: Eight remaining Shanghai attraction records; selected descriptive and visitor-information claims checked against official municipal or venue sources. This is not a complete operational verification.

records.name: Shanghai Tower
claimsReviewed: The official English site describes the sightseeing route including the B1 exhibition hall, 118th-floor observatory, and 125th-126th-floor SKY632 art space
The observatory is described as being 546 meters high
The official site says visitors should carry ID cards or passports
records.notes: Source confirms these descriptive details only. Current opening hours, prices, ticket availability, and entry conditions were not verified.

records.name: Former French Concession
records.notes: Broad historic area; exact boundaries, itinerary and visitor entry points need a dedicated official source review.

records.name: Oriental Pearl Tower
claimsReviewed: The tower is 468 meters high
Address listed as No. 1 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
Official municipal source describes sightseeing, dining, shopping, exhibitions and river-tour functions
records.source: Shanghai Municipal Government English portal; source credits orientalpearltower.com
records.notes: No current ticket price, opening hours, availability or booking rules were verified.

records.name: Shanghai Museum East
claimsReviewed: Address: No. 1952 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area
Official site lists 10:00-18:00, last entry 17:00, closed Tuesdays except national holidays
Individual visitors do not require reservation according to official museum visitor information
Individual entry is through the B1 East Gate after security check with valid ID
records.source: Shanghai Museum official visitor information; Shanghai municipal English guide
records.notes: The museum notes that special galleries and special exhibitions may have separate reservation or ticket requirements; operational details may change.

records.name: Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street
claimsReviewed: Official municipal source describes the street as a shopping destination with department stores, traditional-brand snacks and night views
The municipal source lists the pedestrian street as open 24/7
records.source: Shanghai Municipal Government English portal; source credits Huangpu district government
records.notes: Street access is distinct from individual shops and venues, whose hours vary. Specific entrances and route details were not verified.

records.name: Xintiandi
claimsReviewed: Address listed as Lane 181 Taicang Road, Huangpu District
Municipal source lists the area as open 24/7
The Shikumen area preserves historic building appearance while incorporating commercial functions
records.source: Shanghai Municipal Government English portal; source credits Shanghai Municipal Commission of Commerce
records.notes: Area access is distinct from individual restaurants, shops and attractions, which have their own hours.

records.name: Tianzifang
claimsReviewed: Municipal source describes the area as a historic alley with Shikumen and other architectural styles
Location listed as Alley 210, Taikang Road, Huangpu District
Official source lists open 24/7 and free admission
records.source: Shanghai Municipal Government English portal; source credits Huangpu district government
records.notes: Open-access area information does not verify hours or fees for individual shops, studios, or venues.

records.name: Wukang Road
claimsReviewed: Official municipal tourism source places Wukang Road within the Hengshan-Fuxing Road Historic Reservation Area
Municipal source identifies 14 excellent-rated historical buildings and another 37 conserved buildings along the street
Official tourist service center listed at No. 393-A Wukang Road
records.source: Shanghai Municipal Government English portal; municipal tourism information center directory
records.notes: Street-level description and tourist-center address are supported. No claim is made that the tourist center is the best entrance or that all buildings are open to visitors.
